title: The Last Supper Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Last Supper Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Last Supper Bible crossword: the passover, the upper room, the broken bread and the cup. KJV clues from Luke 22, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A large upper room furnished and prepared, a passover kept with desire, and bread broken with four words attached to it that the church has repeated ever since. The Last Supper covers Luke 22 — the man bearing a pitcher of water who shows them the way, the cup, the betrayer's hand on the table, and the argument about which of them should be greatest.
The clues stay in the room rather than running ahead to the garden; that is its own puzzle. The closing verse is the breaking of the bread.

clues.text: He brake it and gave it unto them
Disciple whose hand was with his on the table

verseText: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
